question: What affliction arises for people when ritual pots and related items lack cloth coverings?
premises: Ritual pots and related items may lack cloth coverings
Such deficiency constitutes a ritual fault
Ritual faults can produce bodily afflictions
inference: If pots and related items are without cloth, people suffer a wind-related disease
plain_english: If the pots and other ritual items are without cloth coverings, a wind-related disease will arise among the people.
